summary: Found 1 security defect: open redirect in login_continue handler
defects: backend/src/mcp_consent.rs:388-397: login_continue handler redirects to unvalidated continue_url query parameter without same-origin check. Lab reference (slice1-lab/src/bin/commoncal.rs:2072-2090) has validate_continuation enforcing relative paths. Production version allows ?continue_url=https://evil.com to redirect authenticated users to arbitrary external sites (open redirect).
important_context: The login_continue endpoint is mounted at /consent/login-continue and is session-protected but lacks open-redirect validation on the continue_url parameter
